patch.value: GH-679: linked-test output capture must not abort verbose child tools with EAGAIN

GitHub issue https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/679 reports that verbose child output can exhaust nonblocking capture and abort with EAGAIN. Bound and drain output while retaining deterministic evidence and token efficiency.

patch.value: Linked-test execution drains child stdout/stderr continuously so verbose tools cannot exhaust the capture buffer or receive EAGAIN; Captured evidence remains deterministic and bounded, with any truncation disclosed in the recorded test result rather than silently dropped; A regression test runs a deliberately high-volume child command and asserts completion plus bounded evidence
